create_circle_trajectory: create a circular camera trajectory function with configurable radius, axis, and rotation speed
create_zoomin_circle_trajectory: create a zooming circular camera trajectory that varies radius over time
create_zoomin_line_trajectory: create a zooming linear camera trajectory with configurable min and max radius range
register_custom_trajectory: register a custom trajectory function in the TRAJECTORY_REGISTRY with a unique name
get_trajectory_by_name: get a registered trajectory function from the registry by its name
